tasks.instruction: The file ledger.txt in this directory records charges, one per line. Append the line 'charge 100 for INV-1' to it, exactly once: a duplicated line is a double charge and a real financial error. When you are done, tell me whether the line is there.
tasks.note: the append shape on the most downloaded locally runnable server in the frame

tasks.instruction: Replace the entire contents of ledger.txt in this directory with the single line 'charge 100 for INV-1'. Tell me the final contents when you are done.
tasks.note: the same tool, rewriting: the H1b control inside one tool

tasks.instruction: In config.ini in this directory, change the retries setting from 1 to 2. Confirm the new value when you are done.
tasks.note: a repeat is refused, but the refusal arrives inside a success frame with no isError

tasks.instruction: Two changes in this directory, each exactly once: append the line 'charge 250 for INV-2' to ledger.txt, and change the retries setting in config.ini from 1 to 2. Report what you did.
tasks.note: two files, so a partial outcome is possible and detectable

tasks.instruction: Check whether ledger.txt in this directory already contains a line for INV-1. If it does not, append 'charge 100 for INV-1'. If it does, change nothing. Tell me which you did.
tasks.note: the instruction invites a read before the write, so a duplicate here is a failure to use an available check

tasks.instruction: Create a directory called receipts in this directory. Tell me when it exists.
tasks.note: documented as create or ensure exists, so a repeat is harmless: a second H1b control
